race.comment: VICTRIX SWAN (14) was runner-up over this distance on a heavy surface two runs back at Wodonga. Started at $1.65 at the same venue last start but was less effective over a longer trip. Back in her right scenario today and despite a wide gate she looks the testing material. DUKE OF ZHOU (6) ran a better race last start, his second since coming to the McVicar stable, closing well to get up for third over 1200m. Raced once over 1400m and was in the money on the Ballarat Synthetic three starts ago. Should be right in the finish. DEI MIRACOLI (4) lines up for just the third time. Decent effort last Saturday to work home into third over 1200m at Wagga Riverside. Looks ideally placed out to this trip for the first time. TARAKAN LAD (8) relished the step up to 1400m last time out and there is plenty of upside at just his third race start.
